description:
## Return YouTube Username v2.2.4

- Fix Settings Menu Alignment (跑版): Use official @layout/preference_with_icon and remove summary from top-level PreferenceScreen to match Morphe's native single-line style and icon layout.
- Remove Redundant Option: Eliminated '替換全域所有 @代號' (Replace all handles globally) which was redundant with the dedicated comment and Shorts switches, simplifying settings to 4 clear, focused options.
- Pure Standalone Morphe Patch Bundle: Only contains Return YouTube Username without duplicating official patches.
- Fully compatible with Morphe 2.1.0+ and YouTube 21.30.216.
